notes.title: TUSFitG selected for the Out Of Index festival!
notes.content:
The USB Stick Found in the Grass will be shown in Seoul on December 3rd, 2022 as part of the Out Of Index event! Unfortunately, I won't be able to visit Seoul in person, and because of the time zone differences, I won't be online during the festival's morning hours. However, everyone is welcome to ask questions on our Discord, which is available around-the-clock.

The game will be translated into Korean by the organizers, but it's important to keep in mind that while the Korean version will undoubtedly be simpler to read, finishing the game without being able to evaluate the original text is difficult. The exact wording of the text affects a number of game elements. Only the versions in English and Polish are officially recognized as being solvable.

notes.title: Nomination for the 2021 Polityka's Passport Award!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38523042/5ee7c6c9c4afa905dc6f27f572727c6019107d37.jpg[/img]

The USB Stick Found in the Grass author nominated for the 2021 Polityka's Passport Award in the Digital Culture category, alongside the extremely talented creators of Gamedec and Papetura!

Polityka's Passport, presented by the Polityka weekly since 1993, is one of the most prestigious Polish cultural awards. The USB Stick Found in the Grass has been recognized by the jury as a very ambitious undertaking ahead of its time, demonstrating how literary quality can be combined with computer technology.

[url=https://www.polityka.pl/tygodnikpolityka/kultura/paszporty/2146098,1,nominacja-w-kategorii-kultura-cyfrowa-marcin-borkowski.read]announcement[/url] (in Polish)

notes.title: Rebuilt the exe with the steamworks sdk v1.51
notes.content: Some people report problems with the game not being able to start due to a failure of the SteamAPI initialization. We have rebuilt the exe with the newest SDK just in case.

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.content: Small bug fix related to the way program communicates with Steam servers. Most of you won't notice any changes.

notes.title: zip update!
notes.content: Small, but important update! If you managed to open first or second zip file in the past, check its content again.

notes.title: Achievements ready!
notes.content: Achievements have been implemented, so you can claim them now. Just click on the file name on the main game screen and enter the password you already know.
